rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides comprehensive management of UniFi Network Controller infrastructure. Supports site, device, client, network, port forwarding, DNS, and firewall operations including both v1 and v2 firewall rules with IPv6 support. Offers lazy mode with meta-tools for token efficiency and eager mode exposing all operations directly, with automatic ID-to-name resolution and per-request caching.
